traceability.notes: All requirements in docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md are fully implemented and covered by tests. Core functionality is present via detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, and generateMaintenanceReport, with a traceability-maint CLI that exposes detect/verify/report/update subcommands. Operations are conservative and only rewrite @story paths, preserving surrounding code and formatting, and offer dry-run and clear messaging for safety. Error handling includes non-existent roots, invalid flags, simulated permission errors, and security checks for unsafe paths. Maintenance tools are documented in README.md and referenced from the API reference. All associated Jest tests pass, confirming behavior and fulfilling the story’s acceptance criteria and requirements REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-UPDATE, REQ-MAINT-BATCH, REQ-MAINT-VERIFY, REQ-MAINT-REPORT, and REQ-MAINT-SAFE.
